remarks: Discover an exceptional opportunity with this spacious multi-family property, perfect for both homeowners and savvy investors. The first-floor unit features 2 bedrooms, a bright living room, a formal dining room, a kitchen, and a full bathroom. The second-floor unit offers even more space with 3 bedrooms, a full bathroom, a living room, a dining room, and a kitchen. A full basement provides abundant storage space and additional possibilities to suit your needs. Ideally situated near schools, shopping centers, restaurants, public transportation, and other everyday conveniences, this property combines comfort, location, and value. Whether you’re looking to live in one unit while generating rental income from the other or expand your investment portfolio with a strong income-producing property, this is an opportunity you won’t want to miss. Both units are currently tenant-occupied, providing immediate rental income from day one, making this an attractive turnkey investment opportunity. Showings start Fri 06/05 at 9am. Negotiations will start Thurs 06/14 at 5pm.
